author: SHARKHATT
quote: GTA 6 feels like a familiar experience wrapped in a fresh coat of modern polish. It has all the ingredients that make Grand Theft Auto great, with the world, characters and gameplay we know and love, but at times it feels more like a refined version of something we’ve played before than a truly fresh **** of my biggest disappointments is the lack of choice when it comes to performance. For arguably one of the biggest-budget games ever made, not having a dedicated performance mode is a strange decision. The option to prioritise frame rate over visual fidelity has become pretty standard in modern gaming, and it’s disappointing not to have that choice here.There’s no denying that all the components **** GTA are here, but it’s a shame that the game hasn’t been released in its best possible form. With a little more flexibility and optimisation, this could have been something truly special.

author: SHARKHATT
quote:
As a lifelong fan of the original Zelda, this new instalment holds a special place in my heart. The original was more than just a game to me; it was a huge part of my childhood and sparked a love for a series that has stayed with me ever since.

Playing this new adventure brings back so many of those feelings while offering something fresh and exciting. It’s a wonderful reminder of why I fell in love with Zelda in the first place. For me, this is more than nostalgia – it’s revisiting a little piece of my childhood and making new memories along the way.

An absolute joy for any Zelda fan.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
